title: Tuscan White Bean and Orzo Stew
description: Orzo cooks directly in white bean broth so the stew thickens as it simmers.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.text: Roughly chop {spin}. Mash half of {beans} to a thick paste.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Heat {oil}, {garlic} and {rosemary} for 1 minute, then stir in {puree} for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add {broth}, all the beans and {pasta}. Simmer together for 10–13 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in the spinach and {parm}. Let stand 2 minutes for the broth to thicken around the orzo.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Option A uses the listed tomato or lemon. For gentler Option B use roasted pepper puree in place of tomato, or omit lemon. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 293 kcal, 16.4 g protein, 46.2 g total carbohydrate, 5.2 g fat, 7.9 g fiber, 122 mg sodium.
